items.title: Suspect to appear in court after R18m drug lab dismantled in Richards Bay
items.summary: The Hawks have dismantled a sophisticated drug laboratory in Esikhawini, Richards Bay, and arrested a 50-year-old suspect who is expected to face charges of drug possession, dealing and manufacturing.

items.title: Egypt: At least 31 killed after fuel truck erupts in flames on Cairo highway
items.summary: A fire erupted in Egypt's capital, Cairo, on Wednesday, killing at least 31 people, the health ministry said, after a fuel truck reportedly overturned on a packed highway.

items.title: Indonesia mine flooding death toll rises to 13, 13 still missing
items.summary: The death toll from flooding in an illegal gold mine on Indonesia's Java island, following heavy rain, rose to 13 with more than a dozen others still missing, a rescue official said Thursday.

items.title: Police committee slams SAPS over detective workload and performance failures
items.summary: Portfolio committee chairperson Ian Cameron says the SAPS’s continued failure to address detective shortages and forensic backlogs is undermining investigations and leaving victims of crime without justice.

items.title: Court allows mother to take son to US to join husband after father insists he should stay due to diabetes
items.summary: A Cape Town High Court judge has allowed a mother to relocate to New York with her 11-year-old son, despite the father’s concerns about his diabetes treatment and loss of contact.

items.title: Yuzriq Meyer suspended by Bush Radio after backlash over autism video
items.summary: Bush Radio has suspended Breakfast Rush host Yuzriq Meyer pending a disciplinary process after a viral video containing derogatory comments about autism sparked widespread backlash.

items.title: Ministers' accommodation costs of up to R80,000 a month questioned
items.summary: Parliament’s Public Works Committee has questioned monthly rentals of up to R80,000 for ministers and deputy ministers

items.title: Family friend sentenced to life for rape of 14-year-old girl after getting her drunk
items.summary: Mpho Bodigelo, 26, was sentenced to life imprisonment after being convicted of raping a 14-year-old girl in Soutpan while she was unconscious.

items.title: Department of Transport faces recovery of R1,3bn eNaTIS bill
items.summary: Parliament’s watchdog has declined to condone approximately R1.338 billion in unauthorised expenditure linked to eNaTIS and recommended that the amount be recovered from the RTMC’s future revenues or allocations.

items.title: ANC seeks two of eThekwini’s top four positions in coalition talks
items.summary: ANC eThekwini coordinator Thanduxolo Sabelo says the party is seeking two of the municipality’s four top political positions as coalition negotiations continue following Tuesday’s swearing-in of 223 councillors.

items.title: BOOK EXCERPT: Stoep stories in Victoria West — Where the Karoo’s quiet streets keep history alive
items.summary: Victoria West’s Karoo history is packed with wool-boom wealth, wartime heroics, devastating floods and an aerodrome that once linked the remote town to the world.

items.title: Thirty-one killed in fire after vehicle overturns in Egypt
items.summary: CAIRO, Nov 25 (Reuters) - Thirty-one people were killed and 21 wounded in a fire after a vehicle carrying petroleum products overturned on a major ring road in Egypt, authorities said on Wednesday.

items.title: XENOBAROMETER: Home Affairs urged to halt Beitbridge refugee office plans amid rights concerns
items.summary: Six refugee rights organisations have called on Home Affairs to withdraw notices shutting Tshwane’s refugee office and forcing tens of thousands of asylum seekers to travel to Beitbridge.
